title: Spring Dice Open
description: Beginner-friendly tournament for Spanish Poker Dice players.
rules: Random-pairing tournament. Most points after all rounds wins.

trophy.title: Golden Dice Trophy
trophy.description: Awarded to the winner of the Spring Dice Open.

title: Weekend Blitz Championship
description: Fast-paced blitz tournament for experienced players.
rules: High-risk blitz tournament with short timers.

trophy.title: Blitz Champion Trophy
trophy.description: Awarded to the Weekend Blitz winner.

title: Classic Dice Masters
description: Long-form classical tournament with strategic gameplay.
rules: Classical format tournament with long time controls.

trophy.title: Masters Trophy
trophy.description: Awarded to the Classic Dice Masters champion.
